releases.name: v1.0.0 for MC 1.21.130
releases.notes:
This is the first release of Nudge!

It features these roadmap items:

-  Selection system
-  Nudge system
-  Move edit
-  Undo / Redo
-  Clone edit
-  Selection rotation / mirroring
-  Delete edit
-  Stack edit
-  Arbitrarily sized edits
-  Ticking areas for edits
-  Entities affected by edits
-  Translation support
-  Magic Delete edit
-  Extrude edit
-  Symmetry Building
